Geographic distribution. Termitoquedius ecitonis is known from the Departments of Junín, Huánuco, and Cusco, Peru, at elevations ranging from 850 to 1303 m. It occurs within the Ucayali and Rondônia provinces, and 3 – 10 km from the border with the Yungas province, all belonging to the South Brazilian dominion (sensu Morrone et al. 2022). The species occurs in close proximity to the Tropical Andes biodiversity hotspot (sensu Myers et al. 2000) (Fig. 4). These localities represent the first country record of the genus for Peru.
